tagline: Larger subscription email attachments: Dashboard subscription emails now support up to 24 MB of combined attachments, up from 9 MB.
what_it_does: Larger subscription email attachments: Dashboard subscription emails now support up to 24 MB of combined attachments, up from 9 MB. Recreate dashboards from screenshots: Genie Code for dashboard authoring now reproduces the visual styling of a screenshot more closely when you recreate a dashboard from it. AI/BI dashboards have limits on pages, datasets, widgets, filter values, rendered rows, subscription attachments, and PDF downloads.
why_it_matters: For information about dataset size thresholds and performance optimizations, see Dataset performance thresholds.
